headline: Wealth Inequality Debate: Billionaire Fortunes vs Worker Pay
summary: Sanders and Reich attack extreme wealth inequality while unrelated voices discuss tech, Murdoch, and Musk.

voices.quote:
Walmart spent $43.4B on stock buybacks from 2019 to 2025, enough to give each of its 2.1M workers annual bonuses of $2,953.

Last year, retiring CEO Doug McMillon pocketed $29.2M — his largest payday

This is what a rigged economy looks like:

Today, we have more income and wealth inequality than at any time in American history, worse than the “Gilded Age” of Rockefeller, J.P. Morgan and Carnegie.
